Explicit residency publication epoch; coherent host mirror and legal source/slot mapping.
Retire victim table mapping on compute stream; copy stream waits its event before overwriting slot.
Publish gate/up and down only after both copies complete; verify slot generation against late completion.

prefill_constraint: Freezing the cache is insufficient: cached slots contain other experts. Restore canonical donor bytes/tables before using original prefill runtime, or redesign and re-budget prefill staging.
host_capacity: Host payload increases by the evictable device-tail payload. Keep a never-evicted core; do not allocate full host copies speculatively or request root/GTT changes.
